goal: Make step 1 of choosing what to work on next one command: list everything across the repos that waits on the human (open human tasks with blockers first, open ledger gates, pull requests waiting for review or merge, open questions), each with a link, instead of reading five files and a PR list by hand (roadmap R47).
changed: bstack gains the waiting-on-me skill and scripts/waiting.py: given repos, or a folder of repos, it lists open HUMAN_TASKS.md items (status tables, Done-checkbox tables and ## Open bullets) with blockers first and what each blocks, gate entries with no later gate-answer in unsealed runs under .audit/runs in each repo and its worktrees, open non-draft pull requests with their check state, and open questions.md bullets with no Answer: line. It reads only and sends nothing.

Every item links to its source: the GitHub URL at the line when the local file matches origin's default branch, else PATH:LINE. A file in no known shape, a torn ledger line, a missing gh or a gh failure is listed under Could not read and the exit code is 1.
ROADMAP.md marks R28, R44 and R47 done. bstack 0.45.0.
